summary: Introduces the Dublin Core, a small set of metadata elements used to describe resources so they can be found. It records the consensus reached on the meaning of each of its 15 elements. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 5013.

eli5.summary: Every book in a library has a card listing its title, author and subject. The Dublin Core is a short standard list of such labels that can be used for anything online.

questions: what are the dublin core metadata elements
